# PostFader tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_tool_reference.py from fl_studio_mcp/mcp_server.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

PostFader gives your AI client **135 tools** and **8 resources** for FL Studio.
You never call them yourself: ask for what you want in plain language and
the AI picks the tools. Use this page to see what is possible, or to check
what your AI did.

53 tools can change the open project. They are refused until write mode is
on for the session; a Production Run turns it on itself when you asked for
changes. PostFader never saves the project, and every other tool leaves it
as it is. Details: [security policy](../SECURITY.md) ·
[exact arguments and results](tool-contracts.md).

## Project and session

Read the open project and control write access and undo.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fl_get_capabilities` | Report direct, partial, unavailable, and unvalidated integration paths. | No |
| `fl_get_project_summary` | Read project metadata, counts, dirty state, version, and transport state. | No |
| `fl_get_transport_state` | Read playback, recording, loop mode, position, and song length. | No |
| `fl_get_selected_range` | Read the current Playlist timeline selection and project PPQ from FL Studio. | No |
| `copilot_capture_readonly_inspection` | Capture a compact project, mixer, and effect inspection report. | No |
| `fl_set_write_mode` | Enable or disable writes for this bridge session without restarting FL. | Turns writes on/off |
| `fl_get_project_history` | Read undo/redo bounds, current history position, hint, and dirty state. | No |
| `fl_undo` | Move to the previous absolute undo-history position and verify it. | **Yes** |
| `fl_redo` | Move to the next absolute undo-history position and verify it. | **Yes** |

## Transport

Playback, recording, position, tempo, and time signature.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fl_set_playing` | Set playback to an absolute state and verify it on a later FL idle tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_stop` | Stop playback, set normalized position to zero, and verify both fields. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_song_position` | Set a stopped transport's absolute normalized playhead position. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_loop_mode` | Set Pattern or Song loop mode without exposing FL's toggle-only API. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_tempo` | Set project tempo while stopped and verify BPM on a later FL idle tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_recording` | Set recording absolutely; FL's toggle is dispatched at most once. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_metronome` | Set the metronome absolutely and prove the later UI state. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_precount` | Set recording precount absolutely and verify it on a later FL tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_time_signature_numerator` | Set and prove beats per bar from FL's PPB/PPQ getter pair. | **Yes** |

## Mixer

Levels, pan, routing, sends, names, colors, and the built-in EQ.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fl_list_mixer_tracks` | List mixer tracks, current levels, selection state, and loaded effects. | No |
| `fl_inspect_mixer_track` | Read one track's state, effects, built-in EQ, and outgoing routes. | No |
| `fl_set_mixer_volume` | Set one mixer fader and report the readback FL gave on a later tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_volume_db` | Set one mixer fader to a target dB readback, between -60 and +6 dB. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_pan` | Set one mixer pan and report the readback FL gave on a later tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_mute` | Set one track's mute state and report the readback FL gave on a later tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_solo` | Set one mixer track's solo state and verify it on a later FL tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_arm` | Set recording arm with one bounded toggle and later-tick readback. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_color` | Set a mixer color, accepting FL-owned differences in the high byte. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_stereo_separation` | Set stereo separation and report FL's later-tick readback. | **Yes** |
| `fl_select_mixer_track` | Make one mixer track active and verify the active-track getter. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_track_eq` | Set gain and/or frequency on one built-in EQ band; at least one is required. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_name` | Rename one mixer track. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_send` | Route one mixer track to another, or stop routing it there. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_mixer_send_level` | Set how much of one track reaches another. 0.8 is unity, as on the fader. | **Yes** |
| `fl_apply_verified_batch` | Apply an ordered list of supported absolute writes to the current FL session. | **Yes** |

## Channels, patterns, and Playlist

Channel Rack, step sequencer, patterns, and Playlist tracks.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fl_list_channels` | List globally addressed channels, mix state, routing, and generator identity. | No |
| `fl_list_patterns` | List pattern identity, length, current state, and empty/default status. | No |
| `fl_find_empty_pattern` | Find the first default-empty pattern without changing the current pattern. | No |
| `fl_select_pattern` | Select one pattern and verify FL's current-pattern getter. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_pattern_identity` | Set pattern name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_pattern_length` | Set pattern length using Image-Line's API 39+ getter/setter pair. | **Yes** |
| `fl_list_playlist_tracks` | List every one-based Playlist track and its controllable state. | No |
| `fl_set_playlist_track_identity` | Set Playlist name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_playlist_track_state` | Set Playlist states; toggle-only selection is dispatched at most once. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_channel_mix` | Set channel volume, pan, and/or mute with per-field readback proof. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_channel_solo` | Set a global channel solo state and verify it on a later FL tick. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_channel_pitch` | Set normalized channel pitch and report normalized/semitone readback. | **Yes** |
| `fl_select_channel` | Select one global channel exclusively and verify the complete selection. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_channel_identity` | Set a channel's name and/or color with per-field readback proof. | **Yes** |
| `fl_route_channel_to_mixer` | Set one global channel's absolute mixer destination and verify it. | **Yes** |
| `fl_get_step_sequence` | Read an explicit current-pattern/channel grid and its conflict digest. | No |
| `fl_set_step_sequence` | Set absolute current-pattern cells only if the observed grid digest still matches. | **Yes** |
| `fl_trigger_note` | Audition a global channel with a bounded note-on/off dispatch receipt. | No (plays a note) |

## Plug-ins and presets

Loaded plug-in parameters, presets, drum pads, and loading on macOS.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugins_scan_loaded_plugins` | Inventory loaded plug-ins without inserting or changing anything. | No |
| `plugins_inspect_parameter_map` | Read a bounded page of exposed parameters; never marks unknown controls safe. | No |
| `plugins_scan_parameters` | De-pad a whole plug-in in one call; prefer this over paging a VST. | No |
| `fl_set_plugin_param_display` | Set a plug-in parameter using the units it displays, not a 0..1 guess. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_plugin_param_option` | Set a parameter that shows words rather than numbers: Key, Scale, Input Type. | **Yes** |
| `fl_set_plugin_param` | Set one inspected plugin parameter to a known normalized value from 0 to 1. | **Yes** |
| `fl_get_plugin_preset_count` | Read FL's authoritative preset count for one loaded plug-in. | No |
| `plugins_list_presets` | Read one deterministic preset page without changing the plug-in. | No |
| `plugins_get_current_preset` | Read FL's current preset name and an index only when it is unique. | No |
| `plugins_inspect_pad_map` | Read generic pad, MIDI-note, color, empty, and mute observations. | No |
| `fl_select_plugin_preset` | Select a known preset on one loaded mixer effect or Channel Rack generator. | **Yes** |
| `plugins_list_available` | Read the native Add menu on macOS; opens/closes the menu and changes focus. | No (local state) |
| `plugins_load` | Load one macOS Add-menu plugin, then identify its new channel or effect slot. | **Yes** |

## Audio analysis

Measure exported audio files. FL Studio's live output is not available.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audio_analyze_file` | Measure level, spectrum, dynamics, stereo, and optional pitch of one render. | No |
| `audio_compare_files` | Measure band deltas over the aligned, loudness-matched common overlap. | No |
| `audio_analyze_masking` | Measure per-band spectral overlap and vocal-minus-instrument level margins. | No |
| `audio_find_recent_bounces` | List the newest audio files in FL Studio's Rendered, Audio, and Projects folders. | No |
| `audio_estimate_tempo_and_key` | Estimate periodic tempo and global major/minor key with ranked ambiguity. | No |
| `audio_transcribe_melody` | Extract a reviewable note sequence from monophonic audio; it does not mutate FL. | No |

## Mixing workflows

Mix Doctor, reference and masking checks, peak watches, and mix plans.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mix_doctor` | Diagnose a real bounce with explicit policy thresholds and no mutation. | No |
| `mix_reference_recommendations` | Return bounded tonal review ranges only when alignment/readiness passes. | No |
| `mix_masking_recommendations` | Recommend bounded dynamic remediation from sample-synchronous stems. | No |
| `mix_start_peak_watch` | Start a process-persistent sampled peak watch and return its first frame. | No (local state) |
| `mix_get_peak_watch` | Read cumulative sampled peaks without stopping the watch. | No |
| `mix_stop_peak_watch` | Stop one process-local watch and return its final aggregate. | No (local state) |
| `mix_create_gain_stage_plan` | Create, but do not apply, dB-fader changes from a peak watch. | No (local state) |
| `mix_list_plugin_profiles` | List bundled parameter-role adapters and processing recipes. | No |
| `mix_inspect_plugin_compatibility` | Report which loaded effects have known parameter-role adapters. | No |
| `mix_resolve_processing_intent` | Map an intent to loaded profiled controls without applying settings. | No |
| `mix_create_plan` | Store proposed mixer/plugin changes for review without applying them. | No (local state) |
| `mix_get_plan` | Retrieve a stored mix plan's operations, rationale, session, and status. | No |
| `mix_apply_plan` | Apply a previously reviewed draft mix plan once to its bound FL session. | **Yes** |
| `mix_finish_assessment` | Run the end-to-end read-only finish assessment and stop at user export. | No |

Generate chords, melodies, basslines, and drums; export MIDI files.

| `compose_chord_progression` | Generate voice-led triads/sevenths without changing FL. | No |

## Piano Roll and arrangement

Read and write notes, transform them, add markers, record automation.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `piano_roll_bridge` | Prepare the separate FL Studio Piano Roll scripting connection. | No (local state) |
| `piano_roll_read_notes` | Open a score and read notes without changing notes or enabling musical writes. | No (local state) |
| `piano_roll_write_notes` | Add supplied notes to a channel's Piano Roll in the specified pattern. | **Yes** |
| `piano_roll_transform` | Transform existing Piano Roll notes in the requested selection or whole score. | **Yes** |
| `arrangement_prepare_pattern` | Find an FL-reported empty pattern, select it, name/color it, and set length. | **Yes** |
| `arrangement_add_section_markers` | Add bar/beat section markers; name readback is available, marker-time readback is not. | **Yes** |
| `automation_record_value` | Dispatch one REC_MIDIController value while playback and recording are active. | **Yes** |

Choose and apply presets from the instruments already loaded.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |

| `sound_selection_get` | Look up one process-local palette without treating expiry as a server error. | No |

## Production Runs

Multi-step jobs that PostFader validates and executes in order.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `postfader_creation_readiness` | Aggregate all detectable setup blockers without changing FL Studio. | No |
| `processing_plan` | Plan loaded-effect processing without enabling writes or mutating FL. | No |
| `processing_apply_plan` | Apply a semantic plan through one task-scoped verified Production Run. | **Yes** |
| `postfader_describe_operations` | List Production Run operations and return exact schemas for the ones named. | No |
| `postfader_validate_run` | Validate a bounded Production Run and current capabilities without changing FL. | No |
| `postfader_execute_run` | Create and execute one task-scoped run until its plan completes or blocks. | **Yes** |
| `postfader_list_runs` | Find recent runs after an MCP restart without executing any operations. | No |
| `postfader_get_run` | Read a current or journaled run, its generated outputs and operation receipts. | No |
| `postfader_continue_run` | Continue or replace only a run's unexecuted remainder after a follow-up. | **Yes** |
| `postfader_stop_run` | Stop future run operations without undoing completed project changes. | No (local state) |

## Creation Review and delivery

Review an exported draft, plan one revision, and prepare delivery.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `postfader_review_start` | Start a bounded Review Session from one completed Production Run. | No |
| `postfader_review_attach_assets` | Validate and attach explicit audio assets without changing FL Studio. | No |
| `postfader_review_evaluate` | Measure one bounce globally and by known section; apply zero FL mutations. | No |
| `postfader_review_get` | Read a Review Session, retained evidence, status, and exact next action. | No |
| `postfader_review_compare` | Compare before and after bounces without implying producer approval. | No |
| `postfader_review_plan_revision` | Compile and validate one bounded RevisionPlan before any project mutation. | No |
| `postfader_delivery_manifest` | Build the final multi-dimensional delivery view without writing a file. | No |
| `postfader_review_export_handoff` | Return one precise full-mix export request and only necessary stems. | No |
| `postfader_review_apply_revision` | Apply one bounded revision with one preflight and one write authorization. | **Yes** |
| `postfader_review_record_feedback` | Record explicit feedback; silence and measurements never grant approval. | No (local state) |
| `postfader_review_stop` | Stop future review work without undoing completed project changes. | No (local state) |
| `postfader_review_delete` | Delete one Review Session record without touching audio or the FL project. | No (local state) |
| `postfader_delivery_export_manifest` | Create local delivery files without overwriting or saving the FL project. | No (writes a file) |

## Saved-project rendering

Render a saved .flp to WAV in a separate FL Studio process.

| Tool | What it does | Changes the project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `postfader_render_saved_project` | Start FL's command-line WAV exporter in a separate process; saved state only. | No (local state) |
| `postfader_render_get_job` | Get render progress and decoded WAV evidence; completed also requires FL exit. | No |
| `postfader_render_cancel` | Cancel monitoring and its owned process; on macOS the renderer may remain open. | No (local state) |

## Resources

Clients that support MCP resources can read these for context. They follow
the same rules as the matching read tools.

| Resource | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `fl://capabilities` | Live verified capability report for the connected FL Studio bridge. |
| `fl://status` | Compact live connection, project, transport, and write-mode context. |
| `fl://project` | Live typed summary of the currently open FL Studio project. |
| `fl://transport` | Live playback, recording, loop, position, and tempo state. |
| `fl://mixer` | Live bounded mixer-track inventory without instantaneous peaks. |
| `fl://channels` | Live global Channel Rack inventory with stable target identities. |
| `fl://patterns` | Live pattern inventory, current selection, identity, and length. |
| `fl://plugins` | Live inventory of loaded mixer effects and Channel Rack generators. |
